sentences.text: This end-of-well review covers wellbore 15/9-F-4 on the Volve field, which has 130 daily reports from 2007-06-09 to 2016-10-13.
The report span is 3289 days, with 124 active days and 5 campaigns.
Total depth is 3510.0 m measured depth and 3138.8 m true vertical depth on the deepest report, and Sodir lists 3510.0 m as total depth.
Total activity time is 2859.0 h.
Primary lost time is 431.25 h, which is 15.08% of the activity time; possible lost time of 279.5 h (9.78%) is reported separately and is not included in the primary figure.
Sodir records the purpose as injection and the status as plugged and abandoned, with entry on 2007-10-13 and completion on 2008-03-09.

The Sodir completion date of 2008-03-09 is the end of drilling, not the end of the well's activity: activities continued after it, through completion, workover and plug and abandonment work, to the last report date of 2016-10-13.
Primary lost time was dominated by a stuck wireline tool that needed fishing, which accounts for 138.5 h, and by weather and exhaust-fume waits, which account for 217.0 h.
Campaign 1 ran from 2007-10-13 to 2007-11-05, a span of 24.04 days with 24 active days, and its dominant operation phase was drilling.
Campaign 2 ran from 2008-02-04 to 2008-04-22, a span of 78.96 days with 77 active days, and its dominant operation phase was drilling.
Campaign 3 ran from 2010-09-23 to 2010-09-26, a span of 4.0 days with 4 active days, and its dominant operation phase was workover.
Campaign 4 ran from 2012-09-11 to 2012-09-15, a span of 5.0 days with 5 active days, and its dominant operation phase was workover.
Campaign 5 ran from 2016-09-30 to 2016-10-13, a span of 14.0 days with 14 active days, and its dominant operation phase was plug abandon.

Section 1 has a hole size of 36.0 in and ran from 2007-06-09 to 2007-06-13, from 145.6 m to 256.5 m measured depth (true vertical depth 256.5 m at section end), drilling 110.9 m of new hole at an average of 3.96 m/h while coded drilling; this rate is an average over all time coded drilling, not an on-bottom rate.
Section 2 has a hole size of 36.0 in and ran on 2007-10-12 with no new hole drilled; no drilling rate is reported because no drilling hours are coded.

Section 3 has a hole size of 17.5 in and ran from 2007-10-13 to 2007-10-22, from 260.0 m to 1360.0 m measured depth (true vertical depth 1334.0 m at section end), drilling 1103.5 m of new hole at an average of 15.49 m/h while coded drilling.

Section 4 has a hole size of 12.25 in and ran from 2007-10-23 to 2007-11-05, from 1363.0 m to 2770.0 m measured depth (true vertical depth 2607.6 m at section end), drilling 1410.0 m of new hole at an average of 12.88 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 5 has a hole size of 12.25 in and ran from 2008-02-04 to 2008-02-08 at 2770.0 m, drilling no new hole; no rate is reported because no new hole was drilled.

Section 6 has a hole size of 8.5 in and ran from 2008-02-09 to 2008-02-27, from 2774.0 m to 3510.0 m measured depth (true vertical depth 3138.8 m at section end), drilling 740.0 m of new hole at an average of 9.83 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 7 has hole size unknown (the tool does not report it), ran from 2008-02-28 to 2008-03-13 with no new hole drilled, and ends at a casing shoe of 3508.0 m.

Section 8 (completion, hole size unknown) ran from 2008-03-14 to 2008-03-16 at 3510.0 m, and section 9 (plug abandon, hole size unknown) ran from 2008-03-17 to 2008-03-18 at 3510.0 m; neither drilled new hole.

Section 10 (drilling phase, hole size unknown) ran from 2008-03-19 to 2008-04-05 with 408.0 h of activity time and no new hole, and sections 11 to 14 (drilling and completion, hole size unknown) ran from 2008-04-06 to 2008-04-15.
Section 15 (workover, hole size unknown) ran from 2008-04-16 to 2008-04-22 with 154.75 h of activity time.

Section 16 (workover, hole size unknown) ran from 2010-09-23 to 2010-09-26 with 61.5 h of activity time and no end depth reported; section 17 (workover, hole size unknown) has no start date reported and ends on 2016-09-30.
Section 18 (plug abandon, hole size unknown) ran from 2016-10-01 to 2016-10-13 with 249.75 h of activity time and no new hole.

Section 1 starts at 145.6 m, but the tool records a casing shoe of 251.2 m at its start, which is deeper than the section start; this is a data inconsistency in the section record, and the tool reports no casing set in section 1.
Section 2 starts below the same 251.2 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 3 starts below the 251.2 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 1351.9 m; the tools give no casing size for this string.
Section 4 starts below the 1351.9 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2760.5 m; no casing size is stated in the tool data.
Section 5 starts below the 2760.5 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 6 starts below the same 2760.5 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 7 starts below the 2760.5 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 3508.0 m.
Sections 8 to 18 start below the casing shoe set in section 7 and set no casing, as the tool records no casing shoe for them.

sentences.text: The casing size stated in the reports appears in the activity comment for the tie-back run, which reads: "RIH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing from surface to 108 m MD according to tally." The tool places this run in section 10, which records no casing shoe.

Primary lost time by section is: section 2, 2.75 h (15.28% of its 18.0 h of activity time); section 3, 2.75 h (1.16% of 238.0 h); section 4, 15.5 h (4.78% of 324.0 h); section 5, 1.25 h (1.26% of 99.0 h).
Section 6 has 170.25 h of primary lost time (45.52% of its 374.0 h of activity time); section 7 has 1.0 h (0.28% of 360.0 h).
Section 10 carries 204.75 h of primary lost time (50.18% of its 408.0 h of activity time), mostly weather and exhaust-fume waits while the riser and wellhead were handled.
Section 11 has 1.0 h of primary lost time (4.17% of 24.0 h), section 12 has 8.5 h (8.85% of 96.0 h), section 15 has 19.25 h (12.44% of 154.75 h) and section 18 has 4.25 h (1.7% of 249.75 h).

By cause, primary lost time is 217.0 h of interruption -- waiting on weather, 138.5 h of interruption -- fish, 36.25 h of interruption -- repair, 20.25 h of drilling -- wait and 19.25 h of interruption -- rig up/down.

Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 137.0 h of interruption -- other, 81.25 h of interruption -- wait, 40.75 h of interruption -- maintain and 20.5 h of workover -- wait.
Possible lost time by section includes 41.75 h in section 10, 61.5 h in section 4, 26.5 h in section 17 and 23.0 h in section 9.
On 2008-02-15, a mud pump failure during section 6 cost 0.5 h of possible lost time; the driller decided to drill ahead on one pump.

On 2008-02-16, the aft pipe-racking system drag chain was found damaged and a loose bar was traced to it; the drag-chain inspection and repair decision on that day cost 4.75 h of possible lost time, and the repair ran into 2008-02-17.
On 2008-02-18, the wireline logging string became stuck during an MDT run, and attempts to work it free over 7.5 h were unsuccessful, coded as primary lost time for stuck equipment.
On 2008-02-19, the wireline was cut and a cut-and-thread fishing operation started, which took 2.75 h of primary lost time on that cut.
Fishing ran from 2008-02-19 to 2008-02-24 and was coded as 138.5 h of primary interruption -- fish across 79 activities.
On 2008-02-24 the fish was caught after 0.5 h of work and the wireline tool string was then pulled out of the hole to surface.
From 2008-03-19 the rig was held for weather and exhaust fumes, and on 2008-03-23 the rig floor could not be worked for 13.0 h of primary lost time.

On 2008-03-28, the production department found a support bracket on the F-12 flowline ripped off during the wellhead inspection, and rig management decided not to start production until it was assessed; this cost 1.0 h of primary lost time.
On 2008-04-03, a fault in the casing tong and its load cell cost 2.25 h of possible lost time while the tie-back run was prepared.

On 2008-04-04, the straddle cup tester leaked during the tie-back pressure test, which took 1.0 h without a test result, and a bolt found on the aft pipe-racking system led to 4.0 h of possible lost time for the repair.
On 2008-04-05, exhaust fumes on the drill floor stopped operations for 12.0 h of primary lost time, and the gas turbines were shut down to restore conditions.
Campaign 3 started on 2010-09-23 as a workover that ran RST saturation logs, and section 16 recorded 61.5 h of activity time over that period.
On 2012-09-12, a wait for an electrician and for the production department to prepare the well cost 6.0 h of possible lost time.
On 2016-10-02, the cement job took 1.75 h with no lost time, and the plug was later tagged on 2016-10-06 after a 0.25 h tag run.
On 2016-10-04, the tubing hanger running tool shear pins sheared prematurely and the tool was repaired, which cost 0.75 h of primary lost time.

The next well on this field should plan for weather and exhaust-fume downtime at the riser and wellhead stage: weather and fume waits account for 217.0 h of primary lost time and section 10 alone carries 204.75 h (50.18% of its activity time).

Before a wireline logging run is lowered into an 8.5 in open hole, the next well should qualify the tool string and its pumps on surface: the MDT string stuck and was cut and fished for 138.5 h of primary lost time in section 6, which had 170.25 h (45.52%) of primary loss.

Inspect the pipe-racking system drag chains and bolts before the next well's riser and wellhead work: the drag chain damage on 2008-02-16 cost 4.75 h of possible lost time and the bolt repair on 2008-04-04 cost 4.0 h.
Verify casing running tools and their load cells on surface before the casing run: the tong fault on 2008-04-03 cost 2.25 h of possible lost time before the tie-back could be made up.
Plan the plug and abandonment cement job with a tag and pressure test: the 2016 cement top was confirmed on the second tag, on 2016-10-06, after the first tag found poor cement.

Record hole sizes and casing sizes and check casing shoe depths in the daily reports: sections 7 to 18 have no hole size reported, section 1 records a casing shoe deeper than its start depth, and the tools give no casing size for most strings.

row.comments: Troubleshot mudpumps. Not able to start mudpump #3. Mudpump #2 gave wrong output on stroke setting. Decided to drill ahead using mudpump #1 only.

Removed lid and inspected inside PRS upper drive. Found rotational dragchain in AFT PRS upper drive to be damaged. Identified origin of loose bar (FG) to be cross member in rotational dragchain. Assessed damage. Decided to perform repair of dragchain.
Repaired rotational dragchain in AFT PRS upper drive. Meanwhile tested MDT tools

Worked WL several times. Slacked off to 5000 lbs and picked up to max tension 12000 lbs several tiems - not able to make progress. Prepared for doing cut and thread fishing on drillpipe. Prepared fishing procedure. Decided to do fluid sampling at stuck point in Heather prior to fishing.

Put 7200 lbs tension on WL. Fitted T-clamp on 7/48 cable and slacked off WL. Cut 7/48 cable with 5-6 m loose end and fitted spear on same. Fitted spearhead overshot and 2 x fishing weights to winch side of wireline. Removed sheave wheel from TDS. Removed sheave wheel from aft samson post.
RIH with 5" DP from 3202 m MD and caught fish at 3221 m MD. Set down ~5 MT on fish and observed indication of succesful catch on surface and downhole WL tension.
Operation suspended due to exhaust fumes blowing into the rig floor. Meanwhile cleaned the moon pool, pit room and pump room.

WOW prior to retrieve the HP riser. Changed out of BOP door seal assy, greased manual valves on choke/kill line. Cleaned pit. Performed general maintenance and PM's. 

Time      Wind speed             Wind direction            Sea        Wave direction
                Knots                            deg                      m                    deg
08:00       17/23                           330°                   2.6/4.1              350°
10:00                                                                      2.3/3.6                
12:00                                                                      1.6/2.6               
14:00                                                                      1.3/2.1                 
16:00       21/24                           350°                   1.8/2.9              330°
18:00       23/26                           340°                   3.1/5.0              340°

14:30-19:00 Not able to work at rig floor, due to exhaust fumes.

Due to findings made by production department, halted operation for inspection in wellhead area. A support bracket on the F-12 flowline/piping was found to be ripped off. Mærsk rig management decided not to start production due to the circumstances. Further investigation/assessment needed before starting production.
RIH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing from surface to 108 m MD according to tally.
Attempted to make up connection, investigated missing torque reading on Mærsk system. Traced fault to be load cell or load cell amplifier.
Filled pipe with approx 1,8 m3 packer fluid prior to testing. Pressured up to 380 bar - observed leakage from B-annulus outlet - not able to obtain test.

Parked aft PRS for repair. Performed repair work on aft PRS. Broke out and re-thightended in total 24 allen/hex bolts with prescribed momentum (600 ft lbs). Replaced broken bolt. 

Meanwhile :
-Installed BX3 elevator in bails
-Brought Vetco/BOT equipment to cantilever

Exhaust fumes on drillfoor and drillers cabin. Suspended drillfloor operations. Checked wind and conditions every 30 min. Monitored well from shaker control room.

Meanwhile :
-Cleaned and tidied in moonpool
-Cleaned and tidied in wellhead module
-Housekeeping in heavy tool store

21:30 - shut down gas turbines to get working conditions on drillfloor.

Waited on Mearsk electrician, prior to hook up all wireline units. Electrician busy with other jobs.
Meanwhile lifted BOP down to BOP deck through hatch on drill floor and prepared wireline equipment.

Lined up valves on the cement head, released bottom dart, mixed and pumped 13.6m3 1,90SG cement, 600l/min. Pressure 130 bar, decreasing to 90bar, indicating cement moving down in the tubing. Displaced lines w/ 0,9m3 of Hi-vis pill. Released top dart. Pumped 12,2m3 of Hi-vis (totally pumped 13,1m3 of Hi-vis). Displaced w/ 37,7m3 of sea water at initial rate of 1000lpm. Increased pumping rate to 1300l/min - 101bar. Reduced pumping rate in the end of displacement to 700l/min - 83bar. Switched to contamination pill. Observed rapid increase in pressure while pumping contamination pill indicating cement plugging into perforations. Shut down after having pumped 3,5m3 contamination pill, 111 bar and monitored WH pressure decline. Recorded final stabilized squeeze pressure of 60bar. Closed swab valve. 
Verified volumes pumped by checking volumes left in the pits and silos. Theoretical top of cement 2755mMD. DHSV was cycled 3 times after 30m3 of sea water displacement was pumped
Attempted to engage THRT to TH. No success, POOH, checked THRT, observed shear pins sheared prematurely. Repaired THRT

Initiated circulation and RIH to tag cement. Down weight 126t. Slowly washed down from 2436m,  500l/min - 10bar, pressure dropped to 8 bar after reaching 2438m. Tagged TOC w/ 10t. Confirmed TOC at 2438m (22m below theoretical TOC)
